get.description: Each rate with its price per gram and how many designs are priced from it. Needs metal-pricing.read.

put.summary: Set a metal rate and reprice its designs
put.description: Creates or changes a rate, keeps a history line, and reprices every design made from it through the catalogue. Answers with how many were repriced and any that failed. Needs metal-pricing.write and catalog.write.

rate_minor.description: The price of one gram in minor units.

delete.summary: Delete a metal rate no design uses

post.summary: Reprice every design at the current rates
post.description: Brings back any variant whose price was changed by hand, or left behind by a failure.

get.description: Each recipe with its breakdown at today's rate and the variant's price now, 50 to a page.

post.summary: Set how one design is priced
post.description: Saves the recipe, prices the variant by it at once and answers with the breakdown in minor units. wastage_bp, and making_value when making_kind is percent, are in basis points. The total is rounded to a whole unit of the currency.

post.summary: Set how designs are priced from a spreadsheet
post.description: A CSV with sku, rate_code and weight_g, and optionally wastage_percent, making_kind, making_value and stones_value, in grams, percent and whole currency. A bad row is reported by its row number and the rest still go in.

200.description: How many were saved, and the rows left out.

delete.summary: Stop pricing a design from the metal rate
delete.description: The variant keeps the price it has now.
